description: This file defines a custom test runner class 'NiaTestRunner' which extends AndroidJUnitRunner and overrides the 'newApplication' method to specify a custom application class 'HiltTestApplication' for dependency injection in tests.

classes.name: NiaTestRunner
classes.description: A custom test runner for instrumented tests that sets up the Hilt dependency injection framework by specifying HiltTestApplication as the application class.

methods.name: newApplication
methods.description: Overrides the default implementation to return a new application instance of HiltTestApplication.
